verdict.rationale: Sardine's own materials claim inline sanctions screening of senders and receivers before funds are released. They also claim explainable scores and routing of higher-risk matches for analyst review in a case-management workspace. Together these cover pre-release screening and some inspection of decisions and matches, but only through marketing-level claims, with no documented decision response or match-detail view. Missing for 10: documented API or dashboard detail showing the decision outcome and the supporting match records (list entries, match scores, matched fields) for a screened payment, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: Inline sanctions checks at authorization: Screen senders or receivers for sanctions risk before funds are released.
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
